blocks.text: What White Rock homes sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 95 detached houses sold in White Rock at a median of $1,565,000, and 251 condos at $542,000. Condos are more than two thirds of White Rock sales, so the city-wide picture depends on which you are buying.

South Surrey and White Rock real estate market stats for October 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in White Rock?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 131 houses listed with 12 sold in the month and 189 condos and townhomes listed with 22 sold in the month in White Rock. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is White Rock a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 9%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 12%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
